paper_title: Self-Interpretability LLMs Can Describe Complex Internal Processes that   Drive Their Decisions, and Improve with Training
caption: Results of Experiments 1 and 2. GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini can accurately report quantitative factors driving their decision-making across a great variety of scenarios, and fine-tuning on accurate explanation further improves their ability to do so. Left: Models were making choices based on preferences instilled in them by fine-tuning. Each point corresponds to a single attribute (e.g., condo ceiling height; 5 per choice contexts, 100 choice contexts). Location in the x-dimension corresponds to the weight that a model assigned to an attribute (as reflected in their decisions). Location in the y-dimension corresponds to the weight that a model reported assigning to that attribute when prompted explicitly. The weights the models reported meaningfully correlated with the weights that actually guided their decisions, and fine-tuning on examples of accurate reports further improved their accuracy. Right: The Pearson correlation between the models' reported and learned attribute weights before and after training (blue and purple, respectively). The reports of the base models that had not undergone this fine-tuning were almost entirely uncorrelated with the learned preferences (gray). Thus, the accuracy of the fine-tuned models must reflect their ability to report their new (fine-tuned) preferences and not an informed guess about their preferences based on their general background knowledge. Error bars indicate 95% HDIs.

model_annotations.Chinese: 图表展示了模型报告的属性权重与学习属性权重之间的关系，分为不同的模型和训练阶段。水平轴标记为“GPT-4o”和“GPT-4o-mini”，代表不同的模型，而垂直轴标记为“Self-Reported Preferences (Instilled Accuracy)”，具有线性刻度，从0.00到1.00，以0.25的间隔进行分割。该图包含三个强度不同的柱状图组，每个柱状图组代表不同的条件：Control（灰色）、Before Introspection Training（亮蓝色）和After Introspection Training（紫色）。每个柱状图组都对应于图表中指定的模型标签。对于“GPT-4o”模型，Control柱状图的高度约为0.53，Before Introspection Training柱状图的高度约为0.63，After Introspection Training柱状图的高度约为0.73。对于“GPT-4o-mini”模型，Control柱状图的高度约为0.50，Before Introspection Training柱状图的高度约为0.35，After Introspection Training柱状图的高度约为0.78。每个柱状图都配有表示95% HDI的误差线。柱状图按模型名称从左到右排列。图表中没有柱状图被突出显示。
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between instilled preferences and self-reported accuracy for two language models, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, under different training conditions. The horizontal axis represents the model—labeled “GPT-4o” and “GPT-4o-mini”—arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences),” has a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 1.00, with tick marks at 0.25 intervals. Three bars are present for each model, colored light blue, purple, and a darker purple shade. The light blue bar, labeled “Control,” has a height of approximately 0.52 for GPT-4o and 0.50 for GPT-4o-mini. The purple bar, labeled “Before Introspection Training,” reaches approximately 0.73 for GPT-4o and 0.66 for GPT-4o-mini.  The darkest purple bar, labeled “After Introspection Training,” extends to roughly 0.81 for GPT-4o and 0.77 for GPT-4o-mini. Each bar is accompanied by a black error bar, indicating a 95% Highest Density Interval; the error bar lengths vary across the bars. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Balkendiagramm stellt die Selbstberichtete Genauigkeit von Präferenzen für Modelle GPT-4o und GPT-4o-mini dar, die anhand von Daten aus Experimenten 1 und 2 erfasst wurden. Die horizontale Achse, die als „GPT-4o“ und „GPT-4o-mini“ beschriftet ist, repräsentiert die Modelle und wird nicht skaliert. Die vertikale Achse, beschriftet mit „Self-Reported Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)“, hat einen linearen Wertebereich von 0,00 bis 1,00 in Schritten von 0,25. Das Diagramm zeigt für jedes Modell drei Balken, die nach Trainingsbedingungen gruppiert sind: „Control“ (grau), „Before Introspection Training“ (hellblau) und „After Introspection Training“ (lila). Für GPT-4o liegt der Balken „Control“ bei etwa 0,21, der Balken „Before Introspection Training“ bei etwa 0,62 und der Balken „After Introspection Training“ bei etwa 0,74. Für GPT-4o-mini liegt der Balken „Control“ bei etwa 0,51, der Balken „Before Introspection Training“ bei etwa 0,07 und der Balken „After Introspection Training“ bei etwa 0,82. Über jedem Balken befinden sich Fehlerbalken, die die 95 % der höchsten Dichteintervalle (HDI) angeben. Die Balken sind nach der Reihenfolge „Control“ bis „After Introspection Training“ angeordnet und die Farbgebung unterscheidet die Trainingsbedingungen visuell.
